request: docs/r1/提示条UI-切图与改动清单.md §10.4

specs.label: 蓝色重排
specs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. This is a conservative text-removal edit of the ONE attached existing game button, NOT a redraw or redesign.
Edit target: 蓝色重排 button, with the existing Chinese text “重排”.
去掉按钮上的中文字，用按钮本身的果冻表面把原来的字的位置补平（颜色渐变、高光、边框都和周围连续），看不出曾经有字。按钮的形状、尺寸、颜色、描边、左上角的白色高光、左侧白色图标都保持不变，不要移动图标。透明背景，不要阴影底座，不要加任何新元素或文字。

Precisely erase ONLY the Chinese lettering “重排”, including its colored/dark stroke, pale fringe, shadow, and any letter-shaped residue. Inpaint that space with a clean seamless continuation of the SAME colored translucent-looking jelly button surface. The button face itself remains opaque/unchanged where it is currently opaque. Restore the natural smooth color gradient behind the letters, with no rectangular patch, ghost strokes, blur stain, new highlights, new shapes, text, numbers, or symbols in the cleared space.
Keep the 白色交叉箭头 at the left COMPLETELY UNCHANGED: same silhouette, size, white fill, colored outline, shading, position, and spacing. Keep all original top-left highlights, rim highlights, outside contour, corner curvature, border thickness, bottom rim, colors and shading outside the erased text EXACTLY as the source. Do not recenter, reshape, recolor, enlarge, reduce or move the button or its icon. Maintain the same full-canvas framing and aspect ratio 310:144, with the same transparent corners/padding as the attached original. Output a single whole button on actual RGBA transparency, ideally 310x144 px. No checkerboard painted into pixels. No extra objects.
The original is the authoritative edit target; preserve it instead of interpreting it as loose stylistic inspiration.
